messages.text: Hey, I bought the monitor stand in three credit-card instalments. I returned it already. Will the instalments complicate my refund?

No—three instalments of a single credit-card payment count as one payment record, so instalments alone won’t complicate your refund. Any eligible refund goes to the original payment. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Would you like me to find the monitor stand order and check its refund eligibility?

continuation.content:

messages.text: Yes, please check the refund eligibility for my returned monitor stand.
